newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Azucarera Pedro sets 200 mln peso capex.
newsitem.headline: Azucarera Pedro sets 200 mln peso capex.

text.p: Central Azucarera Don Pedro (CADP) said on Thursday it had alloted more than 200 million pesos for capital expenditure for fiscal year 1996/1997.
CADP president Miguel Gaspar said in a statement the capital outlay would be to expand and modernise its sugar milling, refinery and distribution facilities.
"CADP is set to expand the production of higher value-added refined sugar products with plans to expand into retailing to end-consumers," Gaspar said.
At present, CADP sells to large domestic food and beverage companies in the Philippines.
The company has a daily capacity to produce 20,000 tonnes of raw sugar and 925 tonnes of refined sugar.
"We are confident about the company's short and medium term prospects due to the sustained economic growth and the expanding demand for sugar," Gaspar said.
